item.title: Power knocked out to 1,000 Eversource customers in Centerville and Osterville mostly restored
item.description: CENTERVILLE – Over 1,000 Eversource customers lost power about 3 PM Wednesday. The utility company blamed equipment for the damage and hoped to have service restored by 5 PM. Shortly after 4 PM, all but a handful of customers had been restored. CWN is checking with Eversource for further information. item.title: Three ambulances called to traffic crash in Centerville
item.description: CENTERVILLE – Three ambulances were called to a traffic crash in Centerville shortly after 9 PM Wednesday. The collision happened at the intersection of Old Stage Road and Prince Hinckley Road. The extent of injuries was not immediately clear. The crash is under investigation by Barnstable Police. item.title: Boat takes down power lines causing outages in Bourne and Sandwich
item.description: BOURNE – A boat in tow reportedly snagged power lines on Route 6A near the Bourne/Sandwich town line sometime before 1 PM Thursday. Power outages were reported in parts of Sandwich and Bourne affecting some 772 Eversource customers. The utility was responding to make repairs. The post Boat takes down power lines causing outages in Bourne and Sandwich appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Man airlifted after falling from roof in Falmouth
item.description: FALMOUTH – A man was seriously injured after reportedly falling about 12 feet from a roof in Falmouth. The incident happened on Winthrop Drive about 3 PM Thursday. The victim was transported to the Falmouth Airpark to meet a MedFlight helicopter to be flown to an off-Cape trauma center. Further details were not immediately available.
